name: Onna Gari 2 M×nsterHunterHunter  ~Onna Gari ni Ikouze!~
original_name: 女狩り2 M×nsterHunterHunter ～女狩りに行こうぜ!～
source:
In this world it's either kill or be killed. Survival of the fittest. The splendor of nature can turn on a dime and ruthlessly cut you down.
Some live a charmed life, and some are in a constant battle to stay alive.

I'm one of many hunters in this dangerous world, and I'm on sabbatical. I see all the newbies donning their armor but I'm not supporting them right now.

It's nice to see them, though. In the early days it was all lunkheads. Now you can peek in on the meeting area and find women, and not just big hairy warriors, but curvy soft ones. Delicious.
Maybe I'll come back on the scene and "help out" these hotties!
I chat up a particularly good looking one...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135262.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界，不是杀人就是被杀，适者生存。大自然的壮丽随时可能骤变，无情地将你斩落。有些人过着受眷顾的生活，有些人则不断挣扎求生。

我是这个危险世界众多猎人之一，如今正在休假。我看着新人们穿上铠甲，却暂时没有帮助他们的打算。

不过，看看他们也不错。早年间到处都是笨重的男人，如今在集会场所还能看到女人，不只是毛发浓密的战士，还有曲线柔软的女性。真美味。也许我该重回舞台，“帮帮”这些美女！
我主动搭话了一位尤其漂亮的女人……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135262.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
